features.name: Puttinggreen vid klubbhuset
features.note: Small distinct green enclosed by the two clubhouse-area buildings and paths; separate from the larger putting green to the southeast.
Visible hardstanding surrounding the enclosed putting green. Interior turf remains an explicit hole. Physical paving material unknown.
Observed car-park apron west of the clubhouse; cars identify use but their positions are not adopted. Footprint clipped against retained building rings.
Visible 2019 northern hardstanding; shadowed edges omitted. Later practice-area changes reported in 2025 are unresolved, so this is explicitly historical geometry.
Separate visible 2019 apron. Tree-covered middle portion is deliberately not joined across uncertain boundaries.
Observed range grass field. Covered buildings, northern hardstanding and southern tee apron excluded. Replaces the broad supplementary OSM range surface, not a surveyed mowing boundary.

Visible northern practice hardstanding with a row of mats. A continuous platform is supported; individual mat count, dividers and dimensions remain unmeasured. OSM way41197436 previously drew this as grass.
Southern mat apron in front of the low range shelter and eastward extension. Shelter footprint and mats are separate physical features; no synthetic pitch-spaced bays.
First clearly visible green practice strip south of the large range building. Exact turf/mat construction unknown.
Second clearly visible green practice strip. The intervening patchy strip is left unresolved rather than joined into one invented platform.
Distinct green target surface within the range. No target flag, daily cup position or distance marker is inferred.
Visible service hardstanding between the large range building and road; excludes the building footprint. No parking stalls or vehicles inferred.
